identities.name: Claude
identities.reason: Claude Code commits with this identity in Pumi's project threads, where the agent is the git author of the commits it writes (decision 0081). Each such commit carries the Signed-off-by line of the person who asked for the work (decision 0082).

identities.name: dependabot[bot]
identities.reason: Dependabot is the git author of the commits in its update pull requests (decision 0115). A person adds a Signed-off-by line to each such commit before it is merged (decision 0131).

identities.name: dependabot[bot]
identities.reason: Dependabot signs off with this email when a repository requires sign-off on web-based commits. Listing it means that such a line does not count as a person's sign-off (decision 0131).
